references_access: Only after all test predictions have been generated and saved
before_generation: Verify freeze, runtime, pinned model snapshot and all input token lengths; reject any over-budget input
generation: Use only the frozen sources, method=baseline, no demonstrations, no adapter; save all raw outputs
evaluation: Use frozen evaluation_v2 after complete prediction export; empty, incorrect and truncated outputs stay in denominator
after_test: Do not tune prompts, decoding or scoring based on final-test answers or scores
failure: Preserve failed-run logs; any retry must keep the same frozen settings and be documented
